instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure both Salon and Restaurant themes switch seamlessly when toggled without page reload.
Verify dark overlay gradients over photo backdrops keep headline and sub-copy text above 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
Ensure mobile layout stacks hero panel smoothly above or below form with responsive spacing.
Add font links for Playfair Display, Caveat, and Outfit in public/index.html if missing.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, steppers, and toggles have required data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, or overlays with underlying text.
Ensure every key interactive element has data-testid attribute.
Use 2-3x generous padding inside bordered containers.
